basis: median contract price of house sales (residences without a strata lot) in the local government area per quarter, computed from the NSW Valuer General's sale records
name: Central Coast (NSW)
notes: Central Coast (NSW): median contract price of house sales (residences without a strata lot) in the Central Coast (NSW) local government area, per quarter, 2001Q2 to 2026Q2, computed by this site from the NSW Valuer General's individual sale records (the Valuer General publishes no median). Each sale is counted once; part-interest sales, dealings of several properties and prices under AUD 10,000 are left out. Suburbs are placed in the 2025 LGA holding most of their residential Mesh Blocks (ABS), so the area is the same in every year. Medians are not mix-adjusted. The last quarter is the last one ending at least 90 days before the newest sale file (later sales still arrive, most of all for strata). Districts: 85 suburbs (houses) and 31 suburbs (strata), each point on 5+ sales and each suburb with 20+ such quarters. Comparison: New South Wales, Greater Sydney and Rest of NSW (ABS Greater Capital City areas; the Central Coast is in Greater Sydney).

volume.basis: house and strata sales in the Central Coast (NSW) LGA per quarter (contract date), NSW Valuer General records
